text:
Anna Chen: Heads up — planning a Terraform apply for the v2.3.1 release networking changes in ~60m. Need infra + IAM sign-off and a rollback plan. Any blockers?
Marco Ruiz: Which modules are changing? VPC or just subnet/NAT bits?
Anna Chen: Main change is module.network plus module.egress-gw. Adding a TGW attachment and a couple SG rules for telemetry.
Priya Patel: Are providers/modules pinned in the release branch? Last time a provider bump caused drift.
Jeff Brown: Confirmed provider.aws is pinned to 4.52.0 in the release branch. Registry modules pinned to commit hashes for this rollout.
Lina Gomez: Any IAM deltas? If roles/policies change we need security review.
Anna Chen: Minimal IAM: adding ec2:CreateTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment to a service role. Pasting diff below.
Anna Chen: ```diff
+ resource "aws_iam_policy" "tgw_attach" {
+   name = "tgw-attach-policy-${var.env}"
+   policy = jsonencode({
+     Version = "2012-10-17",
+     Statement = [{Action = ["ec2:CreateTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment"], Effect = "Allow", Resource = "*"}]
+   })
+ }
```
Marco Ruiz: Security, please review the IAM snippet. If approved, we do a targeted apply.
deploy-bot: terraform-plan | workspace=prod | run_id=tb-9823 | status=plan-complete | summary: 3 to add, 1 to change
Priya Patel: Can we run `terraform apply -target=module.network -auto-approve` instead of a full apply to minimize blast radius?
Jeff Brown: Yes. We'll lock state and run from the CI runner that holds the lock. I'll place the lock and trigger the apply.
Anna Chen: Rollback plan: if TGW attach fails or telemetry breaks, revert by applying branch `release/v2.3.1-rollback-tgw` which removes the TGW and SG changes. QA will validate telemetry after revert.
Lina Gomez: Ops prefers low-traffic window. Can we schedule in the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window?
Anna Chen: Change window is 02:00 UTC. Plan to apply at 02:15 to let pre-checks finish.
Marco Ruiz: I'll be on-call during the apply. If anything odd, abort and run the rollback branch.
deploy-bot: deploy-notice | channel=#eng-oncall | message="TF apply for v2.3.1 networking scheduled 02:15 UTC. State locked by Jeff B. Run ID: tb-9823" :bell:
Priya Patel: Security reviewed the IAM snippet; small scope looks OK. Will add a comment about least-privilege before prod GA.
Jeff Brown: Lock placed. CI runner prepping. Starting the canary (targeted) apply at 02:15 and will post plan/apply output here.
Anna Chen: Please add the exact rollback commands to release notes.
Lina Gomez: Add the rollback commands and the git ref to the release notes so on-call can execute quickly.
Anna Chen: Adding to release notes:
``
# rollback
git checkout release/v2.3.1-rollback-tgw
terraform init
terraform plan -target=module.network
terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.network
```
Jeff Brown: Copy. Will upload plan/apply logs and CI artifact links to the release thread after run.
Anna Chen: Thanks — pinging @security-team and @release-managers for visibility. :thumbsup:
Lina Gomez: +1. Locking this thread; will reopen if we need to escalate.
